name: BOC International (China) Co., Ltd.
summary: BOC International (China) Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the securities business in China. The company offers equity and debt financing, financial advisory, and new third board services; research and institutional business services; wealth management, including financial product distribution, PB services, investment advisory, and repurchase; securities brokerage; credit, such as margin trading, securities lending, and stock pledge; stock options; intermediary business services; and investment management. It also provides securities investment consulting; securities underwriting and sponsorship; proprietary securities trading; securities asset management; distribution of mutual funds; management of publicly offered mutual funds; private equity investment; alternative investment; and futures. The company was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
